production_cnn_lstm.name: Production CNN-LSTM V1
production_cnn_lstm.decision_rule: return > 0 -> UP, return < 0 -> DOWN, else FLAT

gru_v2_challenger.name: GRU V2 Challenger
gru_v2_challenger.decision_rule: return > 0.0005 -> UP, return < -0.0005 -> DOWN, else FLAT

evaluation_gates.sample_size_gate: N >= 60 prospective live trading sessions finalized
evaluation_gates.price_gate: Candidate return MAE < Naive persistence MAE
evaluation_gates.direction_gate: Macro MCC > 0 with UP Recall > 20% and DOWN Recall > 20%
evaluation_gates.significance_gate: Diebold-Mariano test p < 0.05 vs production V1
